QuestInfo.name: Asking After Nella, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p406##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p406# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p406#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p406#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I'm wondering what's happening with that favor I asked of them the other day or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on them for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Hello there, #h0#! So, how is it? Are you getting a bit used to this city by now? By the way, I've been incredibly busy lately because so many people around town keep throwing different requests my way. Sigh... If only there were a free adventurer hanging around somewhere...
1.1: You look a bit curious as to why I'm taking requests from the locals and passing them along to adventurers instead. Heh... Well, it's simple, really. In a city like this, trusting someone and handing them a job isn't exactly easy.
1.2: That's precisely why a person like me is needed here! When people hand their requests over to me, I pass them on to trustworthy adventurers who can then earn a nice reward for the job. Now, wouldn't you call that a win-win deal for everyone?
1.3: Anyway, I'm just far too busy again today, so I'd better get going. I hope you have a wonderful day, #h0#!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
